gen-tourney-gf-alexandria: Tourney spreads wide and bulky, each stroke cut to a single width. Alexandria, sans-serif with a tall body and short stems, gives the blocky heading a lighter partner whose open c terminals keep paragraphs moving.
gen-tourney-gf-amiko: Athletic and bulky, Tourney sets every stroke at a single width and stretches its words with wide tracking. Tourney makes the entrance; Amiko, its terminals flaring outward, carries the sentences.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-bangla: Athletic Tourney is uniform throughout, with no calligraphic swell on any downstroke. And Anek Bangla, wide in its s curves, reads comfortably when the heading is sized well above it.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-devanagari: Anek Devanagari, sans-serif with distinctly open letter mouths, sits under the bulky, widely tracked Tourney. Anek Devanagari gives that heavy heading a lighter place to land, its tall middle zone guiding the eye.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-gujarati: Pipe-like strokes, stretched wide: Tourney looks cut from solid tubing, with bulky little letters. Anek Gujarati, plain sans throughout, supplies the sharpest difference: lowercase rivaling the capitals and a gaping c against all that bulk.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Curves that never thin at the turns make Tourney bulky and stretched wide. Anek Gurmukhi, plain sans with big open counters, would read steadily across paragraphs, its round characters generous.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada, sans-serif with a high, squared-off x-height and terminals stopping well short of the stem. While Tourney stamps out loud, bulky words in constant stencil-like weight, the body simply carries the text.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-latin: Bold Tourney gives diagonals and uprights the same heft, stretching its words wide. Anek Latin handles the finer work, its lowercase rising nearly to cap height and its shapes held open.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil keeps big, round bowls in its lowercase. Tourney makes the loud entrance with wirelike strokes and wide tracking, while Anek Tamil's half-unwrapped c and s shapes handle the quieter reading.
gen-tourney-gf-anek-telugu: Tourney stretches wide and bulky, and its curves never thin out at the turns. And Anek Telugu, plain sans with wide, tall bowls left unlatched, gives paragraphs an open, approachable rhythm.
